== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Jedi Advisor (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_39</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 39), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-39-Jedi_Advisor.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-jediadvisor-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Jedi Advisor (V)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “Never deploys, except to Coruscant. While Yoda here, Force retrieval from your [Virtual Block 5] objective cannot be cancelled (except by Secret Plans). Unless Inner Strength on table, your duel destiny and lightsaber combat totals are cumulatively +1.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1250_39</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 5 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB5-39-Jedi_Advisor-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
